label.summary: Several claims discuss building socialist and democratic socialist societies, prioritizing people over profit and empowering working people. The Democratic party references historical social programs like Social Security, while the DSA explicitly aims for a socialist republic and a working-class society. These claims center on differing visions for the organization of economic and political power.
label.title: Socialism and Democratic Socialism as Political Systems

claims.claim_text: The President says that capitalism without competition isn't capitalism, it's exploitation.
With working-class government, strong unions and social movements organizing everywhere, DSA hopes to build a socialist society where people take priority over profit.
DSA believes working people have the political capacity to defeat the ruling class and create a better society.
DSA workers are fighting to create a U.S. democratic socialist republic.
DSA is building a party aimed at a democratic working-class society.
